## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `324f14e500c148cd3abae5bfee475b04c3e34ec5`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/review.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md + scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh

Inputs read: card 33845 body and its three comments (triage 6894740652, claim 6895971923, os-dev-report 6896316823); PR 33943 body, file list (4 files, +28 −6) and the net diff against `main` (merge-base `895783a1`, equal to `origin/main`); the check-runs on this head. Tree read at the head with `git show`; nothing built or run.

Check-runs on this head at 2026-11-15T14:49Z (their conclusions are the gate verdicts; this record re-runs none):
- `success`: Check Changeset, PR-body guards (claim · duplicate · Part-of · single-writer path), Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check PR Size, Auto Label, filter, Plan Test Core shards, Test UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, Type Check · workspace, Type Check · debt ledger, Type Check · consumer gates, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure.
- STILL RUNNING, no verdict yet: Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · ESLint, Type Check · source gates, Test Core (1/8), Test Core (2/8). The skill ratchet, id-lint, frame-sync and label-description-cap verdicts therefore are NOT in yet on this head; the dev's local exits are the dev's account, not a gate verdict. The seat reads these before ACCEPT.
- No `failure` on the head. The rest are `skipped`.

### ① Derived judgments

Every rule-behaviour change the diff implies, by who does what differently:

1. Seat that keeps the lease table (area-lease L12) writes three columns, not four; the 复核席 column is gone. RIGHT. At the head nothing reads that column: the only mentions of 租约表 outside area-lease.md are seat-lifecycle L11 (reads the SESSION column) and nothing in `scripts/pm/**`, `.github/**`, `docs/**` or AGENTS.md; review routing is `contract-review.md` plus `lanes/review.md` 路由 (knock any review mailbox, the idle one takes it), and `check-owed-reviews.mjs` reads review seats off the seat posts, never off a lease table.
2. Maintainer's same-account word for a review seat (area-lease L13) is now placed 在该复核线程 instead of the unnamed 本线程. RIGHT. It is the thread L25 opens for the review seat and it matches L26 (auto mode honours only the maintainer's own words in that thread). It narrows an ambiguity; it does not widen who may sit.
3. Review seat reading its own charter (review.md L19) now learns the independence bar has an exception that lives in `area-lease.md`. RIGHT as a pointer: the exception was already rule on `main` (area-lease L13), the charter contradicted it by its letter, and the condition stays in one home.
4. Seat thread that lands a PR owing a red-check log read sends a sub-agent to read it; that one read discharges both the no-log line (L41) and `platform-readings.md` 红检查先读日志. RIGHT. `platform-readings.md` L285 and the lines under it state the obligation and the steps, never that the seat THREAD must be the reader; `landing-operations.md` L42 only points there. No hunk is owed in either file.
5. Reader of area-lease.md no longer meets the 插队 pointer line in 区内规则. RIGHT, no behaviour change: see ③(c).
6. Area session signing a record puts its own session id in the signature's third slot as well as on `Session:`. RIGHT. The signature is `LANE#N · ACCOUNT · SESSION` (`seat-post-protocol.md` L29–30), so the third slot is the session, and the writing session is the truthful one; the dev report on the card is signed that way.
7. Opening-round reader (seat-lifecycle L11): the exemption is between SESSIONS (在任 PM 会话) and is pairwise over the whole group (两两互见), so two lease-table sessions of one seat do not stand each other down. RIGHT, and a codification, not a new rule: area sessions sign the seat's own signature (area-lease L36), so under the narrow reading every area would stand down on its sibling's `Claim:` and the mode could not run. The card's premise (no item changes what a seat does today) holds.
8. Whoever runs `ensure-pm-labels.sh`: default mode is a no-op for the eight existing `lease:` objects; `--reconcile` now sets their colour and description. RIGHT, cosmetic on live objects, no reader of the label changes.

No other behaviour change is implied by the diff. Reading four (L10) is untouched.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: the diff touches `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` only, no package, no published schema, no shipped artifact. The label is on the PR and `Check Changeset` concluded `success` on this head. `Clause-②: no` is on the PR body and on the claim, and is right: nothing here narrows or changes a declared capability at a consumer.

### ③ Boundary flags

(a) N14 fork. B IS today's letter. L10 names ONE sample, 首张带同席号 `Claim:` 卡, with no skip clause (L8 by contrast carries 非本 session); L11 then says a lease-table session does not occupy. So when that newest closed card's claim is exempt, reading four yields a non-occupying session and the letter gives no walk-on to an older card: four contributes no stand-down. Does either reading change seat behaviour: B, or no edit at all, changes nothing; A adds stand-downs (a duplicate or recovery session that closed a card under a newer area closure) and lengthens the walk per fire. The dev was right not to pick A inside a card whose premise is wording only. Answered here as far as the letter goes; the choice between writing B down and adopting A is ESCALATED to the seat's decision path, as the report's `needs_decision` already does. Leaving L10 untouched on this head is behaviour-neutral, so it does not hold this PR.

(b) `Part of #33845`. Right: N14 is unticked, `review-checklist.md` L8 requires `Part of` when only the implementable part lands, and the PR-body guard (its Part-of leg) concluded `success`. Consequence for the seat, not the diff: the card stays open after merge, and switching the line to `Fixes` by a later commit moves the head and owes a delta review.

(c) N8 with zero hunk elsewhere, paid by the 插队 line. Verified in the tree. The deleted line was a pointer plus a negative (本文不改队列配置). Surviving homes a reader reaches: the three reasons, the audit comment and the one-jumper rule live in `landing-operations.md` L33–37, which area-lease L46 already sends every landing area to; the queue seat's side is `lanes/queue.md` L20–22, reached from area-lease L14 (队列值守只照 `lanes/queue.md`); queue configuration is reserved to the maintainer at `lanes/queue.md` L28. The restriction binds anyone who uses the relay through `landing-operations.md` itself, so no reader loses the rule, and the file's own L3 (余处已有者只点名 ⛔ 不抄) is honoured. Accepted.

(d) Wording trims for the 120-byte budget. No meaning change in any of the three: 不算占席 → 不占席 (same operative fact: these sessions do not hold the seat); 读数三、四 → 三、四 (the two reading lines are L8 and L10 directly above, nothing else in the section is numbered three or four, and L12 keeps 读数一、二); 实现的 PR → 实现 PR and 同账号坐须 → 同账号须 (grammar only). Measured at the head: each touched file's widest line is 120 bytes; line counts 60, 21, 100, equal to `main` and to the ratchet ceilings; no ceiling row moved (`check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` is not in the diff).

Not verified here, by the read-only shape: the script comment's statement that the eight label objects exist today as auto-created grey with an empty description is the dev's reading of two of them (`lease:A1`, `lease:E2b`); nothing in the review depends on it.

### ④ Design judgment

`area-lease.md`
- N6 (L13), N7 (L12), N8 (L41–42), N11 (L36): each holds against its card item and the files it cites, as judged in ① 1, 2, 4, 6 and ③(c). L42 is a continuation of the L41 rule, names its home in backticks and stays within the file's 60 lines.
- No issue number entered operational text anywhere in the diff.

`lanes/review.md`
- N6 (L19): holds. The charter now agrees with area-lease L13 instead of contradicting it.

`seat-lifecycle.md`
- N12 + N13 (L11): holds, see ① 7 and ③(d). N14 (L10) deliberately untouched, see ③(a).

`scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh` (implements N3)
- The loop seeds `A1 A2 A3 A4 A5 E1 E2 E2b`, exactly the eight areas of the pilot at area-lease L16–19. `label-write.mjs` carries no `lease` vocabulary and no allow-list that would refuse a non-pm label, so the comment's claim (it sends the family like any other label) is true and the seeded names are the ones a seat writes. No script under `scripts/pm/` reads the family; the comment says so and names the rule lines as readers, which is the honest account against the file header's every-label-has-a-reader statement.
- The create line is the ordinary `gh label create NAME -R REPO -c COLOUR -d DESCRIPTION` form, so the reconcile shim picks it up with no opt-out; the description is about 90 characters and distinct per value; colour `0052cc` occurs nowhere else in the file on `main`. The move-the-values convention mirrors the `target:` release-window loop already in the file.

Findings:

- N1 (nit) — `scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` (outside the diff, read not reviewed) still bars every review seat on the PR's own account and cites `lanes/review.md` 独立性 as unconditional (`reviewSeatsOf`, the `isBarred` comment). With L19 now naming an exception, a same-account review seat seated on the maintainer's word is printed `barred`. The disagreement predates this PR (area-lease L13 on `main`) and errs toward over-barring; it belongs on a follow-up card, not in this diff.
- N2 (nit) — review.md L19 says only `area-lease.md` 例外. A reader who does not follow the pointer could take area-lease mode as a blanket exemption; the condition (maintainer's own word in the review thread) is one hop away. Acceptable under the name-not-copy convention; a two-character hint of the condition would close it if a byte ever frees up.
- N3 (nit) — the duty to MOVE the seeded values when a lane re-cuts its table lives only in the script comment; area-lease L11–12 (拆并即改租约表) does not point at the label script. The cost of a miss is a grey label with an empty description, nothing a rule reads.
- N4 (nit) — script comment: "Those two area-lease.md lines" covers three lines at the head (L37 foreign lease, L38 add, L39 read back), and "every lane that runs the mode keeps its cards here" is true of the one lane that runs it today, not a property of the mode (objectui holds lane cards of its own).

No must-fix, no should-fix.

The verdict is on the diff's design at this head. It does not stand in for the eight check-runs still running; a red among them is the seat's to read before ACCEPT.
